SCI MODEL A / PRODUCTION V5 TITANIUM CORE OPTIMIZED

Titanium import-price forecast evaluation

Direct H3, H6 and H12 GBP/kg probabilistic forecasts for HS 810820 and HS 810890. The feature set excludes USGS titanium sponge data and World Bank aluminium/nickel proxies. Model selection uses pre-February-2022 validation and minimizes calibrated MIS among acceptance-eligible candidates.

Stress passes1/4
Post-period passes2/4
Latest data month2026-06
Forecast quantiles7

Decision boundary

V5 uses UK titanium import history, Bank of England FX, ERUC/PPI, supplier structure, seasonality and data-quality features. Cross-metal World Bank proxies and stale USGS inputs are excluded. Selection is aligned with the coverage and interval-score acceptance criteria without using either test period.
